violations.why: irq_umbra (prio 5) can preempt irq_bluff between its write and read of v_fern, so the read may see 1 instead of 0.
irq_umbra can preempt irq_bluff between the two reads, so they can return different values.
irq_ermine (prio 4) can preempt the v_saffron++ in irq_prism (prio 2) between its read and write. The store then overwrites ermine's 10, so that update is lost.
irq_falcon (prio 3) can preempt irq_ember (prio 1) between its two writes of v_sable and read the intermediate state.
irq_vine (prio 3), irq_ermine, irq_umbra or irq_falcon can preempt irq_rust (prio 2) after it writes v_nectar=1. The check then sees a different value.
Any higher-priority ISR that writes v_nectar, such as irq_bluff, can preempt irq_ember between its write and its check.
irq_ermine (prio 4) or irq_umbra can preempt irq_falcon between its write and read of v_nectar.
irq_umbra or irq_falcon can preempt irq_bluff and set v_nectar=1 before its check.
irq_umbra or irq_falcon can preempt irq_prism and set v_nectar=1 before its check.
irq_umbra can preempt irq_vine between its write and read of v_nectar.
irq_umbra can preempt irq_ermine between its write and read of v_nectar.
Higher-priority ISRs can preempt irq_rust and reset v_birch before its check.
irq_umbra can preempt irq_falcon and reset v_birch before its check.
Higher-priority ISRs can preempt irq_ember and reset v_birch before its check.
irq_umbra or irq_falcon can preempt irq_bluff and change v_birch between its write and the later read.
